commitResults.messageTitle: Add integrated MVP acceptance driver for release acceptance
commitResults.messageBody:
Refs #80. Runs first use, samples, a non-sample student across restarts,
every deletion cancellation class, selective sample clear, guards,
injected save and display failures, read-only recovery and restoring a
valid file as one real-window sequence. Checks rendered rows and literal
profile lines, and records the assertion count and runtime in the
transcript. Documents how it combines with the other release acceptance
utilities and why a reproducible JAR needs a clean build.

commitResults.messageTitle: Exclude runtime logs from packaged JARs
commitResults.messageBody:
Non-clean builds can copy runtime log files from the compiled class directory into the distributed JAR. This can expose local execution data and make release contents depend on earlier runs.

Exclude the top-level runtime log directory, verify required and forbidden archive entries during tests, enable assertions for Gradle developer execution, and document the reproducible packaging checks.

The sample load and clear implementation lacks a visual overview of its validation, classification, and rollback paths.\n\nAdd a PlantUML activity diagram and its rendered image to the Developer Guide so the documented flow can be checked against the current implementation.
